title: Tools you can own
why: A local example for exploring the brief and draft workflow.
angle: Useful tools should leave people in control of their work.
hooks: What would you build if your tools were yours?
voice: Curious, warm, and specific. Invite a real conversation.

drafts.threads: What would you build if your tools were yours? We are growing a garden of independent software. Bring a small idea, a useful fix, or a question worth asking.
drafts.instagram: Good tools make room for people. What would you like to grow next?
